findings.body: `statementPeriodOptions(periods)` removes every multi-period option from the choices returned to ordinary Ask requests. The new `accepted` branch permits FYTD only when an already-edited selection is submitted, so a normal statement question cannot discover or choose the existing FYTD period. This directly conflicts with the coordinator ruling that FYTD must be offered and leaves the required multi-period path reachable only through a hand-crafted/saved selection. Include FYTD in the offered options and cover choosing it through the Ask period flow.
